```yaml
name: Update Nix Vendor Hash
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "go.mod"
      - "go.sum"
      - "vendor/**"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-vendorhash:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Nix
        uses: DeterminateSystems/nix-installer-action@v12

      - name: Validate shell script
        run: |
          bash -n scripts/update-vendorhash.sh

      - name: Check if vendorHash needs updating
        id: check
        run: |
          # Get current vendorHash from flake.nix
          CURRENT_HASH=$(grep -A 1 "vendorHash" flake.nix | grep -o '"[^"]*"' | head -1 | tr -d '"')
          
          # Run the update script to get new hash
          NEW_HASH=$(./scripts/update-vendorhash.sh)
          
          echo "current_hash=$CURRENT_HASH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "new_hash=$NEW_HASH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
          if [ "$CURRENT_HASH" != "$NEW_HASH" ]; then
            echo "needs_update=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "needs_update=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Update vendorHash in flake.nix
        if: env.needs_update == 'true'
        run: |
          # Update the vendorHash in flake.nix
          sed -i "s|vendorHash = \".*\"|vendorHash = \"${{ env.new_hash }}\"|" flake.nix

      - name: Commit changes
        if: env.needs_update == 'true' && github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add flake.nix
          git commit -m "Update vendorHash" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: env.needs_update == 'true' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "Update vendorHash"
          title: "Update vendorHash"
          body: "Automated update of vendorHash based on dependency changes"
          branch: "update-vendorhash"
```
